description: This file defines the ServerRequest class implementing the ServerRequestInterface for handling HTTP server requests, including methods for managing request attributes, headers, query parameters, uploaded files, cookies, and body streams.
external_methods: ServerRequestInterface methods like getServerParams(), getUploadedFiles(), withUploadedFiles(), getCookieParams(), withCookieParams(), getQueryParams(), withQueryParams(), getParsedBody(), withParsedBody(), getAttributes(), getAttribute(), withAttribute(), withoutAttribute()

classes.name: ServerRequest
classes.description: Implementation of PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface representing an HTTP server request with methods to access and modify request data such as headers, attributes, query parameters, cookies, uploaded files, and body stream.

methods.name: getServerParams
methods.description: Returns the server parameters, typically from $_SERVER.

methods.name: getUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns an array of uploaded files.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified uploaded files.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified cookies.

methods.name: getQueryParams
methods.description: Returns the query parameters from the URL.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified query parameters.

methods.name: getParsedBody
methods.description: Returns the parsed body of the request, could be array, object, or null.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified parsed body.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns all attributes associated with the request.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Returns a specific attribute value, or default if not found.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance with a specific attribute set.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance without the specified attribute.
